hook: Your rocket lifts off from rented land.
title: Russia pays rent to launch its rockets
description:
Baikonur Cosmodrome sits inside Kazakhstan, but Russia leases it, and the lease runs until 2050. Yuri Gagarin launched from here in 1961, and India's Rakesh Sharma flew from here in 1984. Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Space #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you rent out a launch site? Yes or no
